topic.title: Building Safety Regulator / Higher-Risk Buildings / Gateways
topic.source_contract: higher-risk building criteria, dutyholders, competence, building control approval, change control, golden thread, mandatory occurrence reporting, completion certificate, registration and occupation evidence

scope_guards: A height or storey estimate is not treated as a confirmed higher-risk building classification.
A planning permission is not treated as building control approval.
Submission of a Gateway application is not treated as approval.
Approval at Gateway 2 is not treated as completion certification.
A design change log is not treated as approved change control.
Construction completion is not treated as lawful occupation.
Registration is not treated as satisfaction of all accountable-person duties.
No score or promotion is written without exact classification, approvals, as-built evidence, certificate, registration and lawful occupation.
